name: Idaho Science and Aerospace Scholars (ISAS)
what_you_do: Take an online course made by NASA about space travel. It has eight units and a project. Top students may be invited to a week at the University of Idaho. There you plan a pretend mission to Mars with mentors.
who_can_apply: High school juniors. Other rules are not stated on the program page.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page. Students may earn one science credit.
duration: Online course during the school year. Summer academy is one week for chosen students.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is open. A closing date is not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the 2026-2027 ISAS application online. If you are not a junior yet, join the email list on the program page. Questions: isas@sde.idaho.gov.
notes: The program is competitive. Summer academy dates and cost are not stated on the program page. Program contact is Erin Lanigan at 208-885-1232.
